lead.headline: The claim landed; the lineup was already right
lead.deck: The Steelers D/ST replaced the bye. Nothing on the wire would start. Waddle still has not practised.
lead.body: Bad news first: Waddle has no practice line since his Week 9 concussion and Denver's first report lands later today; Garrett Wilson's quarterback, Geno Smith, starts only if he practises; Warren draws a Philadelphia defence that allows the 5th-fewest running-back points; Boston is on bye. The Steelers D/ST claim landed at 02:59 CDMX for the Packers, so every seat is filled. The lineup as set is the projection lineup, and nothing on the wire would start for you.
